title: Conditional κ = 0.001265931727546219: dual eleven-stage whole-residual hosting
body:
Conditional **κ = 1265931727546219 / 10¹⁸ = 0.001265931727546219**, **0.00655% above #447** at `d3cf3079091bb7e93a23e9cd98e82ccb89697328` and **0.2031% above #445**, using the retained PR442 whole-residual hosting interface. The bit supplier binds: **c = 0.001267536342017397153864**, with freshly rebuilt complex **b = 0.001268142296690675**.

The R740 bit kernel now has 121 pivots, entrance rank149, 114 donor slots and 18 explicit residual isometries. The unchanged PR433 complex local word moves to eleven compressed stages in dimension89. Both suppliers use eight replicas and 9,600 live families, with every helper residual hosted whole: 65,120 bit occurrences and 49,280 complex occurrences. There are no helper banks or padding children.

The new complex row argument keeps the existing **20,161** allowance. The coarse three-level estimate is 21,948 and fails. Instead, `89^9 > 16*64^9` gives depth at most `(9/4)log2(e)+9`; the full row charge is `(76005/4)log2(e)+35361`, strictly below `20161 log2(e)` for `log2(e) >= 32`. Smaller widths use retained finite leaves. No larger external row contract is assumed.

**Passed before submission:** full Linux/Python3.12.3 wrapper; macOS/Python3.14.8 quick wrapper; both with `E8_REPLAY_PHASES=1`, regenerating all 2,918 inherited local Clifford edges. Their exact results, deterministic template hashes and instruction digests agree. New checks include official C++ records, integer source spans, 3,366 nested/reflected bit projector pairs, 1,320 routes per supplier, 8,520 exact complex phase equalities, complete hosted ownership, 22 bit and 19 complex mutations, and all 24 omitted bridge shears on each side. Both rational moment engines, both finite invoices, six bootstrap levels and all 47 strict outer inequalities pass. `make verify-joint` passes all 16 controls. All 262 parent-file pins are unchanged. Receipts are in `research/r740-hosted-rank149-validation/`. CI remains pending separately.

**Regarding #448:** its higher claim introduces cross-family splitting. This PR includes a reproducible, scoped review in `research/cross-family-residual-obstruction/`. Same-family factorization does not justify assigning factors to separate families by a coordinate permutation: for q=3, m=2, a=b=1, `D_(a+b) ⊕ I` has trace90 while `D_a ⊕ D_b` has trace54. The exact complex analogue has traces `4+2i` and `4+4i`. General formulas and the proposed rank-eight/rank-nine cases are checked. This obstructs the stated single-residual routing derivation; it does not rule out a different, fully charged compiler or global regrouping theorem. The new certificate here retains whole-residual ownership.

Reproduce:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-r740-replica32/parent436/requirements.txt
E8_REPLAY_PHASES=1 python -B research/r740-hosted-rank149/verify.py /absolute/new/output
python -B research/cross-family-residual-obstruction/verify.py
```

The conditional all-size compiler, mutable-basis, correlated dirty-helper, compressed-window, restored-work, tape/common-grid, precision, row-divisor, PR442 hosting and analytic interfaces remain explicit. No unconditional multiplication theorem, κ=1 result, new Lean proof or earlier-assumption record is claimed.

Prepared by chafreaky with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Retained credits and exact source pins cover Zhihao Chen #377/#386, icekylinx #433, DaysSky #442, eumemic #436/#440/#441, Henry Grant #234, the prior response-kernel lineage, and all parent notices. #447 is a comparison point; #448 is the independently reviewed proposal, credited to Sreekanth Nair with Anthropic Claude assistance.
